systems.name: 3.1 Sprite Picnum to DoomEdNum Mapping
systems.notes: Witchaven sprites (picnums) must be converted to Doom thing types (DoomEdNum). Create exhaustive mapping tables for all Witchaven 1/2 enemies, items, and decorations.
tasks: Dump all sprite picnums used in Witchaven maps
Map each picnum to a DoomEdNum (e.g., Witchaven zombie → 30001)
Allow user to edit mapping via sprite remapper tab
Export mapping to DECORATE definition file

systems.name: 3.2 Actor Definitions (DECORATE/ZScript)
systems.notes: Provide a base DECORATE/ZScript actor definition set for Witchaven/TekWar enemies and weapons so the UDMF maps are immediately playable in GZDoom.
tasks: Implement placeholder DECORATE actors for all Witchaven enemies
Add simple AI (chase, attack) to each
Create weapon actors matching Witchaven arsenal

systems.name: 3.3 TekWar Specifics
systems.notes: TekWar uses a different set of sprites and possibly custom entities. Map its pickups and enemies separately.
